description: selfhosted: helm-values covers image.repository/tag pairs in values.yaml; the custom managers cover everything the annotation comments mark — CHART_VERSION pins in upgrade.sh, ARG pins in Dockerfiles, combined repo:tag image strings in values/templates, and Chart.yaml appVersion (same depName as the values tag, so both land in one PR). Deliberately unmanaged: minecraft MODRINTH/MODS (unsortable IDs, moves with the client pack), claude-code@latest, OP_VERSION, kelsey-green's git-sync deploy branch, and everything ghcr.io/zdiemer/*.

customManagers.description: CHART_VERSION pins in values-only upgrade.sh scripts
github-release *_VERSION pins in upgrade.sh (KubeVirt/CDI ship operator YAML, not a helm chart)
Annotated combined repo:tag image strings in values files and templates
Chart.yaml appVersion mirrors the chart's primary image tag (scripts/check-appversion-drift.sh enforces the convention)
Split string image/tag pairs in values files (arr stack); permits explanatory comments between the keys
Annotated standalone tag shared by image strings (vmlab)

packageRules.description: CrowdSec runtime must match the source tag of the temporary partial-line backport; remove this pin with the custom image (infra/crowdsec/README.md)
KubeVirt and CDI move together — CDI is built against a KubeVirt release
buildkit lockstep: infra/buildkit image tag + claude-workspace buildctl ARG must match
claude-workspace tool binaries in one PR
minecraft deploys only in player-offline windows; PRs on demand via the dashboard
claude-mod gradle pins move with the mod build, by hand; fabric/mojang maven registries aren't resolvable anyway
jellyfin server bumps can strand the Intro Skipper plugin — its builds are pinned to an exact server version (media/jellyfin/README.md)
romm targets the mariadb 11.4 LTS series (prebackuppod dump image tracks it) — offer patches, not the next minor series
prebackuppod dump-image majors follow the app DB major, manually (pg_dump/mariadb-dump must match their servers)
kubectl follows the deployed K3s minor; update this bound with the cluster
buildctl stays on the deployed BuildKit daemon series until both are upgraded together
Apartment Watch is retired; retained source is reference only
